extraction.Name: James Edward Schmidt
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 8, 1920, by O. L. Dice
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to W. H. Tackett for $3000; conveyed by deed to Evelyn A. Schmidt for $6400
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739621 issued; Northwest quarter section 26, township 38, north of range 27; receipt issued April 2, 1920, by the allottee; mortgage dated May 5, 1920; conveyance dated October 23, 1920, by James Edward Schmidt and wife to Evelyn A. Schmidt

extraction.Name: Patsey McLane (Reed)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded October 6, 1925, by D. A. Sinclair
extraction.Buyer: Patsey McLane Reid and Francis E. Reid mortgaged the land to Union Central Life Insurance Company for $5000, due in 20 annual installments, interest at 6½%
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: In March 1929, when the records were viewed, the 1927 taxes amounting to $164.72 and the 1928 taxes amounting to $125.26 were unpaid
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612764 issued; Southeast quarter of section 10, township 99, north range 74; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee February 7, 1918; mortgage dated October 10, 1925
